description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that contains a LogView and a ScrollView, used for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages view creation, styling, and auto-scrolling behavior when log content changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, with auto-scroll on new log entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when log text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
